First, let's sketch the graph of $y=\operatorname{arctan}⁡(2+2x):$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13996467/assets/2ba0e6cf85e73ee89063e487611a64292a21496f93ef2457ae5e5b15cb1478b3.png)

The domain of $\operatorname{arctan}⁡(2+2x)$ is $(-\infty ,\infty ).$ Moreover, from the graph, we see that

$$
{lim}_{x\to \,-\infty }\operatorname{arctan}⁡(2+2x)=-\frac{\pi }{2}.
$$

Therefore,

$$
{lim}_{x\to \,-\infty }3\operatorname{arctan}⁡(2+2x)=3\cdot (-\frac{\pi }{2})=-\frac{3\pi }{2}.
$$
